title: BookFlow
tagline: Multi-tenant booking platform for local businesses
description: BookFlow is a SaaS booking system that lets barbershops, salons, clinics, and tutors manage appointments, clients, and payments — all from a single dashboard. Each business gets an isolated workspace with custom branding.
problem: Local service businesses rely on phone calls, WhatsApp, or pen-and-paper to manage bookings. This leads to double-booking, missed appointments, and no visibility into revenue or client retention.
solution: A multi-tenant platform where each business gets a white-labelled booking page, automated SMS/email reminders, a real-time calendar, and a revenue dashboard — no technical knowledge required.
features: Multi-tenant architecture with isolated data per business
Real-time availability calendar with conflict detection
Automated SMS/email reminders via Twilio & Resend
Public booking page with custom subdomain per business

title: JanVaani
description: JanVaani (Hindi: "voice of the people") is a platform where citizens can file complaints about civic issues — potholes, water leaks, garbage overflow — and track resolution in real time. An LLM routes complaints to the right department automatically.
problem: Government complaint portals are opaque, slow, and offer no feedback loop. Citizens file complaints without knowing if they will ever be read, let alone resolved.
solution: A citizen-facing app with photo upload, GPS tagging, and AI-powered department routing. Officials get a prioritised queue; citizens get status updates and public upvotes show urgency.
features: AI-powered complaint classification and department routing
Photo upload with GPS location tagging via Mapbox
Real-time status tracking with push notifications
Public upvote system to surface urgent issues
Official dashboard with priority queue and SLA tracking
